english:
Firing a Rocket Launcher consumes 1 Armor Charge to grant Godslayer Warheads for 4.5 seconds:
• 15% increased damage
• 100 Reload Speed
• 20 Handling

Godslayer Warheads stacks with everything.

Firing another Rocket Launcher while the buff is active does not consume additional Armor Charges.
